fields.rationale: States cluster by how demanding their reciprocity criteria are: some just require a valid equivalent license, others add a meaningful practice-duration floor, others layer on state exams plus practice history, and the most demanding states combine multiple substantive hurdles (practice years, exam, background check, data bank, CE, etc.).
